title: Medicare Exclusions
description: Understand non-Medicare services including employment and driver medicals, insurance reports and other private-fee appointments.
text: Fees & Medicare Medicare Exclusions A clear guide to services that may attract a private fee because they are outside standard Medicare-funded general practice care. Fees & Medicare Some services sit outside Medicare. Woolloongabba Medical Centre provides 100% Medicare bulk billing for standard Medicare-eligible general practice consultations for patients with a valid Medicare card. Some services are provided for employment, licensing, insurance, reporting or other non-Medicare purposes and can attract a private fee. Common Medicare exclusions Pre-employment medicals — assessments requested for employment or workplace purposes. Driver medicals — including commercial driver medical assessments and other licensing-related medicals. Insurance reports — reports, certificates or information prepared for insurers or other third parties. Other non-Medicare services — services that are not eligible for a Medicare benefit, including some reports, forms, procedures and administrative medical work. Fees may apply. Contact reception for pricing details before your appointment. Where a private fee applies, the practice aims to explain the charge in advance wherever practical. Before you book Tell reception what the medical, form or report is for. This helps the team arrange the right appointment length and tell you what documents to bring. Some assessments require specific forms, identification, reports or testing. Read about medical assessments and procedures → Patient questions Frequently Asked Questions Are all services at the practice covered by Medicare? No. Standard Medicare-eligible general practice consultations may be bulk billed, but some services are outside Medicare and attract a private fee. Are pre-employment medicals covered by Medicare? Pre-employment medicals are generally undertaken for employment or administrative purposes rather than treatment of an illness and may attract a private fee. Do driver medicals attract a fee? Driver and commercial driver medical assessments may be non-Medicare services and may attract a private fee. Contact reception before booking for current pricing and appointment requirements. Are insurance reports covered by Medicare? Insurance reports and other reports prepared for third parties are generally not standard Medicare-funded consultations and may attract a private fee. Related information Fees & Billing → Bulk Billing → Medicare → Contact Reception →

title: Medicare
description: Find Medicare card, rebate and bulk-billing information for Woolloongabba Medical Centre, with official resources.
text: Patient Information Medicare A simple guide to Medicare cards, rebates, updating your information and useful official resources. Information for patients of Woolloongabba Medical Centre in Brisbane’s inner south. At your appointment Please bring your current Medicare card or Medicare number and any relevant concession card. We use this information to confirm billing eligibility and process eligible Medicare rebates electronically at reception where applicable. Medicare and your appointment Medicare is Australia’s universal health care system. If you are enrolled, Medicare may cover some or all of the cost of eligible health services. Bring your Medicare card or Medicare number to your appointment so we can confirm your details and billing eligibility. Your Medicare card If your card is lost, stolen, damaged or expired, Services Australia allows you to request a replacement through your Medicare online account linked to myGov or through the myGov app. A digital Medicare card can also be available through myGov. If your address or contact details change, update them with Medicare and let reception know so we can keep your practice record current. Medicare rebates If a service is bulk billed, Medicare pays the provider directly and there is no Medicare rebate for you to claim separately for that service. If you pay privately for an eligible service, we may be able to submit an electronic Medicare claim on your behalf, or you can claim through Medicare.
